breaking_news.headline: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
breaking_news.summary: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.

breaking_news.headline: Chicago entrepreneur turns empty downtown office space into vertical gardens
breaking_news.summary: The pandemic changed how and where the world works, leaving behind a lot of empty office space. One entrepreneur is starting to plant the seeds of a partial solution.

breaking_news.headline: Eastern Kentucky welcomes data centers in hopes they make up for coal losses
breaking_news.summary: In Kentucky's former coal country, data centers are a welcome sight as people hope they will bring in money.

breaking_news.headline: A Binance engineer thought he was interviewing for a job. Then the hackers pounced
breaking_news.summary: North Korean hackers pulled off the biggest cyber heist ever by duping a Binance engineer into thinking he was being recruited for a job, the crypto exchange says.

breaking_news.headline: Legendary photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
breaking_news.summary: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.

breaking_news.headline: Does the blue wave mean lower gasoline and diesel prices soon? Don't hold your breath
breaking_news.summary: A new Democratic majority in Congress could pressure the president to end the war in Iran. But it will be harder for them to directly affect fuel prices, which are tied to a complex international oil market.

breaking_news.headline: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
breaking_news.summary: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

breaking_news.headline: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
breaking_news.summary: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.

breaking_news.headline: Joshua Wong, face of Hong Kong's pro-democracy protests, jailed for 10 years
breaking_news.summary: Wong, 30, is among hundreds of Hongkongers detained under the controversial national security law.

breaking_news.headline: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
breaking_news.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.

breaking_news.headline: The Pitt and ER are similar enough for lawsuit to proceed, judge rules
breaking_news.summary: The widow of ER creator Michael Crichton argues The Pitt is effectively a reboot of the 1990s series.

breaking_news.headline: Manhunt in western Turkey after eight killed in series of shootings
breaking_news.summary: Eight people have been killed and one seriously injured in a series of shootings in western Turkey.

breaking_news.headline: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
breaking_news.summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

breaking_news.headline: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
breaking_news.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

breaking_news.headline: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
breaking_news.summary: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

breaking_news.headline: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
breaking_news.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

breaking_news.headline: Pound rises to its highest level since the Brexit referendum
breaking_news.summary: Pound reaches highest level against a basket of currencies since the Brexit referendum a decade ago.

breaking_news.headline: Second buyer makes rescue bid for Poundland as retailer faces collapse
breaking_news.summary: A little-known investment group has made a bid to buy the business.

breaking_news.headline: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
breaking_news.summary: Graduates are spending more time managing AI, but are they missing out on other work experience?

breaking_news.headline: Drunk and dangerous e-bike riders face on-the-spot fines under crackdown
breaking_news.summary: A consultation will consider fines and other ways to clamp down on dangerous e-bike riders.
